resource_evidence_boundary: All 27 setup/query/finalization maxima, process counts, sample counts and resource summaries match both canonical Git-backed full and summary reports. Sampling includes the worker, evaluator/corpus and live descendants at 20ms intervals, can count shared mappings more than once, and reports observed lower bounds rather than unique physical memory. Only maxima and summary counts are exported; no per-sample process trace is available, so this audit cannot reconstruct RSS time series or establish the cause of adverse observations. The separate formal old-data resource gate supplies no waiver for fresh resource changes.

retained_adverse_component_observations.assessment: Retained adverse descriptive observations at the 100000-character component ranker boundary, without formal ABBA pairing. The setup RSS maximum includes evaluator/corpus and up to two observed processes, can double-count shared mappings, and lacks a per-sample process trace. Cause is unresolved; neither an isolated library regression nor harmless noise is established. This boundary is outside the registered old-data token/char performance gate; no measurements were rerun or substituted.

limits: This audit recomputes arithmetic from saved ranks, hashes, coordinates and metric fields; omitted original questions/responses are not independently rescored, re-tokenized or projected against source text.
The 54 quality cells include18native and36offlinecomponentprojections. Six projections share the first search; they are not additional searches. Native component reads remain a separate cost.
Q2 native/component persisted vector hashes match; no independently measured query-embedding equality is inferred.
Different component transports and supplied-page representations do not establish whole-product speed or generated-answer accuracy.
Every question is answerable and comes from the same HotpotQA source; small diagnostic groups and the absence of unsupported questions limit generalization and abstention claims.
All losses, per-query delta lists and adverse descriptive latency/RSS observations remain in canonical reports; no best-run selection or retrieval repetition was used.

retained_adverse_native_observations.assessment: Retained adverse descriptive native finalization observation. The cause is unresolved. This sampled process-tree maximum includes the evaluator/corpus and up to two observed processes, can double-count shared mappings, and is not isolated runtime memory. The formal old-data resource gate does not waive or explain this fresh observation.
